notes: Design notes are included. GPT 6.2 Sol is first, then DeepSeek/GPT 6.0 Sol/Kimi/Gemini/ChatGPT/GPT 5.6 Luna. GPT 6.2 Sol and GPT 5.6 Luna use the revised experimental prompts; GPT 6.2 Sol has a test report and full manifests. XD-01 is a D2 hard variant.
caution: n=1 per model/card; no repeats; no formal K/M scoring; GPT 5.6 Luna is a user-labelled deep-thinking web run; GPT 6.2 Sol is a web run with a self-reported test report; XD-01 is a stress test; the L5 is animated but structurally distorted; the static first attempt is archived.
